subject: Operations
title: Supply Chain Resilience
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Supply Chain Resilience.

hook.text: Two companies face the same earthquake. One recovers in days, the other in months. The difference is resilience.

buildup.text: Resilience is the ability to absorb disruption, adapt quickly, and recover to normal or better performance.

discovery.text: It comes from redundancy, flexibility, visibility, and collaborative relationships across the supply chain.

twist.text: Resilience costs money upfront—extra suppliers, safety stock, flexible contracts. It pays off when disruption hits.

climax.text: Toyota's supplier association shared recovery resources after the 2011 tsunami—collective resilience in action.

punchline.text: Resilience isn't free. Neither is collapse.
